verdict.rationale: The docs describe skills as plain `SKILL.md` files in folders. You can copy them into a repo's `.claude/skills/`, and any single SKILL.md can be pasted into any chat to run as a mode, with no Claude Code required. Helper scripts are plain standard-library Python and outputs land in an ordinary `replica/` folder, so nothing is proprietary or binary. Missing for 10: documented setup for other named harnesses (e.g. Codex, Cursor), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the portability claims.
